---
title: "Totali per Persona"
format:
  html:
    include-in-header:
      - text: |
          <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/css/dataTables.bootstrap5.min.css">
    include-after-body:
      - text: |
          <script src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.7.1.min.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/jquery.dataTables.min.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.datatables.net/1.13.7/js/dataTables.bootstrap5.min.js"></script>
          <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>
          <script src="totals.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<div class="container">
<div class="row justify-content-center mt-5">
<div class="col-lg-10">

<div class="card shadow">
<div class="card-header bg-primary text-white">
<h3><i class="bi bi-calculator"></i> Totali per Persona</h3>
</div>

<div class="card-body">
<div id="loading" class="text-center my-5">
  <div class="spinner-border text-primary" role="status">
    <span class="visually-hidden">Caricamento...</span>
  </div>
  <p class="mt-3">Caricamento dati in corso...</p>
</div>

<div id="error-message" class="alert alert-danger" style="display: none;"></div>

<div id="summary-container" style="display: none;">
  <div class="row mb-4">
    <div class="col-md-4">
      <div class="card bg-light">
        <div class="card-body text-center">
          <h5 class="card-title">Totale Generale</h5>
          <h2 id="total-general" class="text-primary">€ 0</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-md-4">
      <div class="card bg-light">
        <div class="card-body text-center">
          <h5 class="card-title">Numero Persone</h5>
          <h2 id="total-people" class="text-success">0</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="col-md-4">
      <div class="card bg-light">
        <div class="card-body text-center">
          <h5 class="card-title">Media per Persona</h5>
          <h2 id="average-person" class="text-info">€ 0</h2>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <table id="totalsTable" class="table table-striped table-hover">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Nome</th>
        <th>Totale Importo</th>
        <th>Numero Transazioni</th>
        <th>Media</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
    </tbody>
  </table>

  <div class="mt-5">
    <canvas id="totalsChart"></canvas>
  </div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>
</div>
</div>
```
